fact: The executive director of the Universal Health Insurance Authority said that after five years in the first-phase governorates, electronic medical files holding medical history have been created for citizens served, with linkage to the private sector planned next.
title: المدير التنفيذي للتأمين الصحي الشامل: ربط القطاع الخاص بالمنظومة يتيح ملفًا طبيًا موحدًا للمواطنين
